data.title: GitHub Code Quality Targets Maintainability as AI-Generated Code Increases
data.description: GitHub Code Quality is now generally available on GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team. The service combines CodeQL analysis with AI-assisted detection of maintainability and reliability problems, then uses Copilot Autofix to suggest changes for review in pull requests, according to an announcement from GitHub.
